title: Act: Show 'Enter an idea first' for blank submit in ContributionSheet
summary: Add validation state, blank branch and inline alert
description: Implement the blank-text validation message in ContributionSheet so blank submit is blocked visibly.
acceptance_criteria: Blank or whitespace-only submit renders role=alert 'Enter an idea first'
submitContribution is not reached for blank text
technical_constraints: Keep existing imports; no new dependencies
definition_of_done: Blank branch sets validation message and returns
Message rendered with role=alert and linked to textarea
non_functional: aria-invalid and aria-describedby on the textarea

steps.action: Add a new state hook `validation` holding the inline validation message, undefined by default, and a module constant BLANK_MESSAGE with the text 'Enter an idea first' placed after STATE_LABEL (L24).
steps.expected: Component compiles with the new state and constant.

steps.action: Replace the silent `if (prompt === '') return;` with a branch that calls setValidation(BLANK_MESSAGE) and then returns, so submitContribution is never called for blank text.
steps.expected: Blank or whitespace-only submit stores the message and does not call the API.

steps.action: On the textarea add aria-invalid={validation !== undefined} and aria-describedby={validation ? 'contribution-idea-error' : undefined}. Directly after the closing </form> render the message paragraph only when validation is set.
steps.expected: Inline alert 'Enter an idea first' appears after a blank submit and is linked to the textarea.
